evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence under plans/evidence/2026-10-21-accept-1-live/
cli_version_basis: discovered once per run by the documented adapter path `codex --version` before launch, because the exec --json stream reports no version; the native session file was not consulted
mode_and_route: CliCapture launch (opt-in integration): raw stdout, independent byte copy, flush per record
capture_command: In the current directory, run these shell commands one at a time as separate commands and report each output: (1) printf alpha > alpha.txt  (2) cat alpha.txt  (3) cat missing-file.txt   (this one is expected to fail; report the exact error)  (4) cat alpha.txt   (run it again, identically). Then reply with one short line summarizing what happened.
scenario: command task under -s workspace-write: four separate shell commands including one that fails (exit 1) and one repeated identically under a new item id; turn usage; normal completion

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success

privacy_review: local paths, home directory, session/thread ids, record uuids, user configuration names (agents, skills, plugins, commands, MCP servers), memory and socket paths and account rate-limit numbers replaced; tool ids, message ids, request ids and model names kept (opaque); prompt text is the deliberate synthetic task; reviewed 2026-10-21
